concerns.text: Phase 6 (Scaling Law Analysis, Tasks T070-T077) implements features entirely absent from spec.md (FR-001 to FR-009). The spec defines the scope strictly as PSM/DiD causal inference on EIA/ACS data. These tasks represent unapproved scope creep and have no matching FR/SC in the specification.

FR-008 mandates a fallback DiD estimation strategy. Tasks T054 and T053 implement a 'Longitudinal Data Check' that logs a warning and proceeds with OLS if data is missing, or halts. They do not implement the actual DiD algorithm required by FR-008. The spec requires the system to 'implement a fallback... strategy', not just detect missing data and fallback to OLS.
Tasks T076 and T077 (Phase 7) are tagged to document the 'Scaling Law Analysis' (Phase 6). Since Phase 6 has no matching FR/SC in the spec, these documentation tasks also lack a valid spec anchor.

Tasks T070-T077 are tagged with [US3], but the Scaling Law Analysis is a distinct parallel stream not described in User Story 3 (Causal Effect Estimation). This tag is stale/incorrect as it implies these tasks belong to the US3 scope defined in spec.md, which they do not.
